name: blocked-links
description: Clean site whose /terms, /privacy and /security pages answer a plain 403 to the audit's fetcher (a WAF or user-agent allowlist), while every sampled page is served normally.

expected.notes: Three sampled internal links (footer Terms, Privacy, Security; also linked from the home body) return 403 with no challenge fingerprint. Per the registry that is a fetcher block, not broken links: en.links.blocked_cluster is an inconclusive info finding listing the three, en.links.broken_sampled passes, and no severity count changes. The sampled role pages are all 200, so cr.access.http_error passes and every other check matches clean-site.
